mapper.select: SELECT * FROM lookup_items WHERE user_id=#{user} AND occurrence_key=#{key}
SELECT * FROM lookup_items WHERE user_id=#{user} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM lookup_items WHERE user_id=#{user} AND book_id=#{book} AND chapter_id=#{chapter} AND type=#{type} ORDER BY lookup_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM lookup_items WHERE user_id=#{user} AND type IN ('word','phrase') ORDER BY lookup_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lookup_items WHERE user_id=#{user} AND type IN ('word','phrase')
mapper.update: UPDATE lookup_items SET explanation=#{explanation},translation=#{translation},grammar_analysis=#{grammarAnalysis},reading_strategy=#{readingStrategy},dictionary_json=#{dictionaryJson},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM lookup_items WHERE user_id=#{user} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN next_review_at <=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND review_status!='mastered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS due,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN review_status='mastered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS mastered FROM lookup_items WHERE user_id=#{user}

SELECT paragraph_index,COUNT(*) AS total,SUM(CASE WHEN type='word' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS words,SUM(CASE WHEN type='phrase' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS phrases,SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('grammar','sentencePattern') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS grammar FROM lookup_items WHERE user_id=#{user} AND book_id=#{book} AND chapter_id=#{chapter} AND paragraph_index IS NOT NULL GROUP BY paragraph_index ORDER BY paragraph_index
